description: Tender Offer Calculator: the site's own MCP server — calculator, enquiry (enquiry = a human...

tools.name: calculator_describe
tools.description: The inputs this calculator takes (with units, ranges and defaults), the outputs it returns, and the assumptions and tables behind it.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Run the Tender offer proceeds and gain calculator: Gross proceeds from the tender; Cost basis of the shares sold; Gain on the sale; How the IRS describes a gain held that long. Missing inputs fall back to their documented defaults.

shares.description: Shares you would sell into the tender

held.description: How long will you have held the shares on the sale date?

tools.name: enquiry_describe
tools.description: Read first. States plainly what submit_enquiry does on Tender Offer Calculator: it starts an enquiry with Tender Offer Calculator, whose team reads it and replies directly. Nothing is bought, ordered or paid; no quote is guaranteed; it is free. Also returns who receives the details, the consent wording, and how the person confirms.

tools.name: enquiry_fields
tools.description: Every field of the Tender Offer Calculator enquiry: key, label, type, whether required, help text and the allowed options where there are any. Pass answers to submit_enquiry keyed by field key.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submits an enquiry to Tender Offer Calculator: NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show the person the summary and the consent line. Step 2: only if the person agrees, call again with the same answers, consent=true and the confirmation token; the enquiry is then submitted, and the person receives an email with a link they must click before the Tender Offer Calculator team sees it. Consent means the person has read and agreed to: "I agree that my tender question goes to a tax adviser who handles startup equity."

answers.description: the person's answers, keyed by field key

consent.description: true only when the person has agreed to: I agree that my tender question goes to a tax adviser who handles startup equity.

confirmation.description: the confirmation token from step 1, after the person has approved the summary
